questions.stem: The passage describes a school project about environmental awareness. According to the text, what can be inferred about the students' approach to the problem? The passage mentions recycling, saving water, and daily life habits.
options: They combine practical actions with awareness
questions.explanation: The text suggests combining practical actions with awareness.

questions.stem: Based on the table and chart showing different countries' energy consumption, which conclusion can be drawn? The graph compares renewable and non-renewable energy sources. Compare the data and choose the best inference.
options: All countries use the same amount
Countries differ in their energy mix
Renewable energy is not used anywhere
questions.explanation: Different countries have different energy consumption patterns.
